text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It happened while I was out with Royce and 
Royce. We decided to go for a walk to get 
some daily exercise, but—
choice_data_list: My legs are getting a bit tired...!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, that's how it goes until you get 
used to it. In that case—let me give you 
some advice on how to walk.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
First, relax your entire body. Then slowly 
lean your center of gravity forward, 
stepping out as if catching yourself from 
falling.
choice_data_list: L-Like this?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Yes, just like that! Good job! This way, 
you should be able to move around without 
getting tired!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Impressive. You're a quick learner, 
Trainer.
choice_data_list:
Instruction just like a pro's... Could it 
be?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu... Sharp deduction! I actually 
earned a "Professional Walking Instructor" 
certification in the past.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
I'm glad I could be of help. Well then, 
shall we continue?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And just as I tried to walk— the sole of 
my shoe suddenly ripped right off, and I 
nearly fell flat on my face!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Are you okay?! Are you hurt, Trainer?!
choice_data_list:
I don't have one... but I can't walk like 
this.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
...Hm. Let me see your shoes. I see... The 
sole has peeled off.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
If it's just this much, I should be able 
to fix it. Could you give me a little 
time?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Alright... there we go. Now let's wait a 
bit for the glue to dry.
choice_data_list: Thank you!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
I'm glad I could be of help. Getting 
certified as a 'Shoe Repair Technician' 
was well worth it.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu.
choice_data_list: What's wrong?
What's wrong?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"I just thought, 'How nostalgic.' A long 
time ago, you see—"

text_block_list.name: Young Royce
text_block_list.text: Ugh... Mama...

text_block_list.name: Royce's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Wah, you're covered in mud! Did you fall!? 
Are you okay!?

text_block_list.name: Young Royce
text_block_list.text: "I'm okay. But... my shoes..."

text_block_list.name: Royce's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Oh dear... The sole is peeling off. Looks 
like I'll have to buy a replacement.

text_block_list.name: Young Royce
text_block_list.text:
Eeeh!? B-But... These are my favorite 
shoes...!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"...I think I was still in the early years 
of elementary school. I went to buy new 
shoes, but I just couldn't give up on them 
after all."

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"And right there, I had a fateful 
encounter. With a sign reading, 'Shoe 
Repairs Accepted.' And so, I said..."

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: "I'll fix it myself!"
choice_data_list: How did it come to that!?

text_block_list.name: Young Royce
text_block_list.text:
"I think it's better for both cost and 
time if I can handle simple repairs 
myself!"

text_block_list.name: Young Royce
text_block_list.text:
Besides, the way shoes wear down changes 
depending on your running form! You can't 
do "self-analysis" without knowing your 
shoes!

text_block_list.name: Shoe Store Clerk
text_block_list.text: ...I-Is... is that so...?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Hmm. Back then, I was a bit too bratty, 
and my cuteness self-production wasn't 
quite complete. It wasn't very like me.
choice_data_list: ...No, I think that's totally like you.
...No, I think that's totally like you.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
And... I tackled the first certification 
exam of my life. ...I was the youngest one 
taking it, though.

text_block_list.name: Young Royce
text_block_list.text:
(So this is the exam venue... Everyone 
around me has such an intensely serious 
look on their face...)

text_block_list.name: Young Royce
text_block_list.text:
(Ugh, I'm so nervous...! I'm the only kid 
taking it, too...)

text_block_list.name: Young Royce
text_block_list.text:
(—No! You can't get cold feet! I have to 
be able to handle this much... and keep 
expanding what I can do!)

text_block_list.name: Young Royce
text_block_list.text:
(I am—Royce and Royce! The Umamusume who's 
going to become the "strongest"!)

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Look, this is the photo from my passing 
celebration party! The certificate is 
still framed and displayed at my parents' 
house.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"...I was so happy. Whenever there's more 
I can do, it feels like my world expands 
just a little bit."

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"I did this. So what's next? Can I do 
something even more amazing?! Can I reach 
an even more incredible place?! Like 
that."
choice_data_list:
You never forgot that joy all this time, 
did you?

You've held onto that happiness all this 
time, haven't you?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. ...The glue should be just about dry 
by now.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Shall we finally set off this time? ...It 
turned out to be quite a long 
conversation, after all.
choice_data_list:
I feel like I've touched upon the core of 
your strength.

I feel like I've touched the very root of 
your strength.

...Maybe I should try getting some kind of 
certification too.

...Maybe I should try getting some kind of 
certification too.

text_block_list.text:

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
It sounds a bit exaggerated when you put 
it like that... But you're right. A 
footing built with your own legs won't 
crumble easily.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
And... I've always had a feeling that 
together with you, we could reach an even, 
far more incredible place.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Yes—toward that destination called "the 
strongest."

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. Would you like to take a step 
forward too? The feeling of being able to 
do more and more. The feeling of your 
world expanding!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
The more you taste it, the more addicted 
you'll get. ...I'll be cheering you on, 
Trainer!
